drawer.title: Personal guide
drawer.noResult: No action matches. Try another word.

end.missing: This screen has changed since the guide was written. Open it yourself.

empty.noHabit: You need a habit first: start with "Create a habit".
empty.noOkr: You need an objective first: start with "Create an objective".

create.label: Create a task
create.synonyms: new task, add, todo, to do
create.b1: Only the name is required. A task can be saved right away.
create.b2: Priority sorts your list: important tasks rise to the top.
create.b3: With a due date, the task shows up in the calendar and can repeat.

find.label: Find a task
find.b1: Search by name, or filter by category to keep a single topic.
find.b2: The calendar shows your tasks by due date.

create.label: Create a list
create.b1: Name your list: groceries, project, reading…
create.b2: Its color sets it apart at a glance in the list bar.

plan.label: Schedule a task
plan.synonyms: time blocking, slot, drag, plan, book
plan.b1: This button opens your tasks to schedule, next to the calendar.
plan.b2: Drag a task onto a slot: it becomes a block in your calendar.

event.label: Create an event
event.b1: Click and drag over an empty slot to create an event at that time.

views.label: Switch view
views.b1: Day for detail, week for the big picture, month to step back.
views.b2: Zoom tightens or widens the hours of the grid.

create.label: Create a habit
create.b1: The habit's name, phrased as an action: read, walk, meditate…
create.b2: How long it takes you each day, in minutes.
create.b3: Its color, used in tracking and statistics.

track.label: Track your habits
track.b1: Pick a view: today's checklist, or each habit's history.
track.b2: Check a habit to complete the day and extend your streak.

create.label: Create an objective
create.synonyms: okr, objective, goal, key result, ambition
create.b1: The objective says where you want to go: one clear sentence.
create.b2: The deadline sets when you review it.
create.b3: Key results measure progress: a number to reach, or done / not done.

progress.label: Move an objective forward
progress.synonyms: progress, update, advancement, key result, category
progress.b1: Update each key result from the card: the objective's gauge follows.
progress.b2: Filter by category to see only one area of your life.
